claim_boundaries.q1_tabpfn: 231 features plus KFold; protocol check only, not ranked against 227-feature fixed 175/75 main models
claim_boundaries.q2: holdout association replication only; no causal or mechanistic claim
claim_boundaries.q3: zero violations mean hard-constraint compliance, while holdout realism worsened in 42 of 48 units
claim_boundaries.q4: no consumer liking label; descriptors and cross-retailer prices are proxies only

known_caveats: The canonical Q1 prediction model artifact is absent; it was not recreated or fabricated.
Q2 has correlated-group redundancy in 23 of 50 dimensions; conditional attribution was not run.
Q3 real holdouts contain only 3-9 beers per style; style-level rankings remain unstable.
Q4 lacks direct consumer liking or purchase labels, and prices mix currencies without conversion.
The bundled DOCX render helper could not rasterize because Poppler was absent from PATH; the final Word PDF was instead rasterized with pypdfium2 and all 36 pages were visually reviewed.
